Spiritual Discourses

Discourse 1: The Criteria for Humanity

I have been asked to discuss the question of the criteria for humanity. If we were to do so from the viewpoint of biology, this would be an easy matter .

But is humanity limited to the body? Is human perfection confined to man's physical aspect?

The View of the Philosophers

Man is a rational animal .

  • Knowledge is not the criterion.
  • Self-sacrifice comes closer.

Hadrat Ali, peace be upon him, said: العلم in his testament1.

  • 1. Nahj al-Balagha, Letter 45.
  • 2. Mathnavi, Book 1.
